latin: Vtrum recte multitudo scibilium ad decem praedicamentorum / numerum sit reducta.
translation: Whether the multitude of knowable things has rightly been reduced to the number of the ten categories.
translator: original translation, drafted 2026-09-26 by WRITER-light-batch10, from Latin at farmer1998:24144
translation_note: 'praedicamenta' = the Aristotelian categories, or predicaments (farmer1998:24144); the source text breaks the word across a line ('praedicamentorum / numerum', farmer1998:24144), reproduced here as given.
